scenes.say: This woman survived the sinking of the Titanic. And that was not even her only shipwreck.
Her name was Violet Jessop. She worked as a stewardess on giant ocean liners.
In 1911, she was on board the Olympic when a warship smashed into its side. She walked away.
A year later, she joined the Olympic's sister ship. The Titanic.
It hit an iceberg, and sank in less than three hours.
Violet escaped in lifeboat sixteen. Someone handed her a baby to look after.
Then, in World War One, she served on the third sister ship, the Britannic, a hospital ship.
It hit a mine. As her lifeboat was pulled toward the giant propellers, she jumped into the sea.
scenes.sub: the Britannic sank in under an hour

scenes.say: She hit her head, but she survived. Three ships, three disasters, one woman.
They called her Miss Unsinkable. She lived to the age of eighty three.
